create.name: Alexander John Shaia
create.bio:
Alexander John Shaia is a writer and teacher of Christian contemplative practice who developed Quadratos, a way of reading the four gospels as four stages of one journey of change. He grew up in Birmingham, Alabama, in a family of Lebanese descent rooted in Maronite Catholicism. After studying cultural anthropology at Notre Dame he trained in counselling, religious education and clinical psychology, earning a doctorate, and went to Switzerland to learn sandplay with Dora Kalff; he remains a teaching member of the international sandplay society. Years of retreat leadership, parish ministry and teaching followed.

Quadratos pairs each gospel with a question that every life meets: Matthew with facing change, Mark with moving through suffering, John with receiving joy and Luke with maturing in service. He sets out the approach in his book Heart and Mind, now in its third edition, and his shorter book Returning From Camino helps pilgrims settle back into ordinary life. With a small team he runs online learning cohorts, a weekly gospel reflection built on his own translation, a membership community and two-year Heart and Mind Circles, and he has given several online courses with The Shift Network. He divides his time between northern New Mexico and the Atlantic coast of north-west Spain.

books.title: Heart and Mind: The Four-Gospel Journey for Radical Transformation
books.author: Alexander John Shaia
books.description: His main book, setting out Quadratos: the four gospels read as four paths that answer life's core questions about change, suffering, joy and service. This third edition carries the same text as the 20th-anniversary hardback, Radical Transformation.

books.title: Returning From Camino
books.author: Alexander John Shaia
books.description: A short guide for pilgrims coming home from the Camino de Santiago, or from any long journey or major change, on settling back into ordinary life and carrying the experience forward.

courses.title: The Four-Gospel Journey: Foundational Program
courses.description: An eleven-session online cohort that walks the four gospel paths through his film series, set readings from Heart and Mind, reflection and sharing in a small group. Cohorts start in September, January and May, either as a recorded study or a smaller unrecorded contemplative circle.

courses.title: Quadratos Membership
courses.description: A tiered membership that brings the weekly gospel passage in his translation, the live or recorded reflection hour and community gatherings, with discounts and the film series at higher levels. The first level has a 28-day free trial.

courses.title: A Heart and Mind Circle
courses.description: A small group of five to eight people with a convener who move through the Four-Gospel Journey together over about two years as a process of spiritual formation. Circles are formed as people register interest.

free_resources.title: The Quadratos Map
free_resources.description: A one-page PDF diagram of the four paths and the questions tied to each gospel, useful alongside the book or a study group.

free_resources.title: Explore the Four Paths
free_resources.description: A free online introduction to each of the four paths, linking the season, the gospel and the life question that belongs to it.

free_resources.title: Episode 7: A Quadratos Meditation - Absorb the Deeper Rhythms
free_resources.description: A guided meditation of about seventeen minutes from the Quadratos channel, inviting listeners to rest in the rhythm of the four paths.
